## Description

tests/ai-evals: ≥ 50 synthetic/de-identified consultations covering code-switching (Hindi/English, Tamil/English), relatives' voices, noise, missing allergies, medication strengths, negation, interrupted recording, contradictions, report-to-patient mismatch. Python offline harness computes critical omission, unsupported assertion, speaker attribution, wrong-patient attach, dose error, fabricated medicines/doses. CI job runs on any change to prompts/models/schema and blocks merge on regression.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Evaluation set exists with ground-truth notes reviewed by the clinical advisor; no real patient data.
- [ ] **AC2.** The CI gate runs automatically on prompt/model/schema changes and blocks on any fabricated medicine or dose (exit gate 1 requires 0).
- [ ] **AC3.** Metrics are reported separately, not as a single score, in an evaluation report.
- [ ] **AC4.** Evaluation results are versioned with prompt hash and model version.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
